name: Village of Tarrytown
gaps: Schedule attachments are dated 12-15-2008; later amendments to Ch. 305 text were read for FAR, impervious coverage, yards, pools and ADUs, but schedule numbers were not cross-checked against newer local laws.
max_building_coverage records total coverage of all buildings; principal-building limits are in each spec's note.
Multifamily districts: no impervious limit (§ 305-49 covers single-family districts only) and no Table 1 FAR cap; recorded as text.
M-1 uses the R-5 one-family limits per § 305-33A(1); Attachment 6 M-1 row differs (coverage 32.5%, no height).
M-3 one-family max stories printed as 22.5 in Attachment 6; recorded as 2.5.
R-80 undersized lots 76,231-79,999 sf: Table 2 lists no FAR.
45-degree light exposure plane (schedule note 1) and special setbacks (Route 9, Tarrytown Lakes, Old Croton Aqueduct, § 305-47C) are not modeled.
MU, WD/WGBD and other non-residential districts not checked for one-family rules beyond LB and NS.

wetlands.summary: Ch. 302: wetlands, watercourses and a regulated 100 ft upland adjacent area need a permit for regulated activities.

steep_slopes.summary: § 305-67: slopes of 25%+ (and wetlands) on sites under review are excluded from building areas, and 50% of them is excluded from lot-size and coverage calculations; high ground (300 ft+) and hilltops also protected.

trees.summary: Ch. 281: permit to cut down, top or destroy any tree over 4 in. diameter (at 4.5 ft) on private property.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 258: SWPPP for land disturbance of 5,000 sf or more, or 1,000 sf or more of new impervious cover.

adu.summary: § 305-14B(15) (L.L. 2-2023): one ADU per single-family lot in all R zones by Building Department permit, owner-occupied, 300-1,000 sf and max 50% of the main house, max 2 bedrooms (studio/1 BR in R-10, R-7.5, R-5); new detached ADU buildings only in R-80 to R-15.

general.accessory_structures: Attached accessory buildings follow principal rules; detached ones follow the schedule's accessory distances, max 12 ft high (§ 305-53). Sheds/playhouses up to 100 sf may sit 3 ft from side/rear lines outside the front yard (sheds max 9 ft) (§ 305-47B(9)).
general.pools: Accessory structure meeting district setbacks but never less than 15 ft from lot lines; 4 ft fence, screened landscaping (§ 305-54).
general.notes: Corner lots (except R-5): side-street yard equal to the front yard (§ 305-47E). Fences max 6 ft (§ 305-47B(7)).

R-80.name: R-80 One-Family Residence

max_building_coverage.note: All buildings (principal max 8%; 10% on lots 60,000-80,000 sf). Schedule notes 3 and 5.

max_impervious_coverage.note: Impervious surface coverage, gross lot area (§ 305-49)

max_floor_area.note: § 305-25: lots at or above the zone minimum get the Table 1 cap; undersized lots use Table 2 FAR (lot rounded down to the nearest 1,000 sf). Decks, patios and unenclosed porches excluded; basements count by exposed-foundation share (§ 305-26).

accessory.notes: Detached accessory buildings: 30 ft from side and 30 ft from rear lot lines, 30 ft from the principal building (schedule cols 15-17); max 12 ft high (§ 305-53B); off side-street lines by the front-yard depth (§ 305-47E).

R-80.notes: Building walls may not cross a 45-degree light exposure plane from neighboring setback lines (schedule note 1). Max livable area 1.5 x principal building coverage. Planning Board may reduce lot size, frontage and yards (not below R-30 lot size) without adding lots (note 2). Table 2 FAR stops at 76,230 sf ('76,231+ None'), so undersized R-80 lots of 76,231-79,999 sf have no listed FAR.
